MemoriaHub CLI v1.3.4
Usage: memoriahub settings [options] [command]

View and update CLI settings (concurrency, attempts cap, etc.)

Options:
  -h, --help         display help for command

Commands:
  list               Print all settings and their current values
  get <key>          Get the current value of a setting
  set <key> <value>  Set the value of a setting
  reset [options]    Factory-reset the CLI: removes config, database, and all
                     local state (irreversible)
  help [command]     display help for command
